company_blurb: Kestrel Labs is a Helsinki-based software and hardware studio building industrial telemetry tools and edge-computing platforms for Nordic logistics and energy firms. Known for steady execution, clean engineering, and practical operations, the team balances technical ambition with careful financial planning.

departments.culture: Engineering values clean code, peer review, and pragmatic problem solving. Developers keep mornings quiet for deep focus, gather for brisk afternoon standups, and document architectural tradeoffs openly before shipping updates.

Finance operates on predictable rhythms, crisp spreadsheets, and transparent cost tracking. As the largest group on the floor, the team collaborates closely during month-end close while maintaining calm, methodical habits.

Legal is a compact, detail-oriented pair focused on intellectual property filings, clear contract language, and regulatory readiness. They favor early reviews and practical guidance that keeps other teams moving smoothly.

Sales blends friendly persistence with clean pipeline hygiene. The team focuses on long-term industrial accounts, clear territory planning, and tight coordination with technical leads before promising custom timelines.

personas.bio: Ville Niemi has spent eight years at Kestrel Labs designing embedded firmware and mentoring newer developers. Outside work, he restores vintage bicycles and enjoys quiet weekend hikes.
Kalle Hamalainen builds forecasting models and tracks quarterly spend across product lines. He brings a structured mindset from his statistics background and runs local five-kilometer races.
Tuomas Karjalainen manages mid-market client relationships across Northern Europe. Energetic and organized, he enjoys hosting customer workshops and cooking big dinners for friends.
Maria Hamalainen coordinates contract reviews, trademark filings, and vendor paperwork for the legal desk. Colleagues appreciate her calm patience and thorough checklists.
Kaisa Laine handles monthly reconciliations, accounts payable, and audit preparation. She prefers clear spreadsheets over long meetings and spends evenings tending her balcony garden.
Janne Virtanen oversees budget controls and internal reporting calendars in Finance. Direct and dependable, he keeps close watch on project margins and coaches youth ice hockey.
Sanna Lehtonen maintains the CRM pipeline, territory assignments, and commission tracking for Sales. She loves swapping podcast recommendations in the office kitchen.
Mikko Salminen manages regulatory documentation, ISO standards alignment, and policy updates. He communicates with precision and enjoys classical guitar in his spare time.
Aleksi Virtanen analyzes SaaS renewal metrics and unit economics for upcoming product releases. Always happy to brainstorm over coffee, he brings cheerful energy to spreadsheet reviews.
Venla Lehtinen processes payroll entries, expense reimbursements, and tax filings with steady accuracy. She is friendly, approachable, and bakes cardamom buns for team birthdays.
Iida Jokinen co-manages financial close cycles and capital allocation summaries. Focused on efficiency, she keeps messages brief and unwinds with winter sea swimming.
Noora Salo coordinates architecture reviews, sprint priorities, and cross-team technical roadmaps. She enjoys lively whiteboard debates and organizing Friday demo sessions.
